compaction_gate: No removal of only copies before checksummed canonical derivatives AND all frozen diagnostic requirements have been independently verified. This preparation authorizes no deletion and sets no storage budget.
retention: Keep immutable task/execution/seed/model provenance, all required scalar outcomes and Full12 numerators/denominators for every episode. For detailed tasks retain lossless compressed required per-step Full12/PV/control/longitudinal/native-eligibility arrays and primary-window occupancy/speed/type maps sufficient for the frozen analysis profiles and illustrations. No whole-road snapshots by default. Shared B1 references use the SAME detailed physical execution, not a second observer run.
